audits.summary: The flow chart is clear and well-structured with a title, legible labels on all nodes, no text overlap or clipping, and effective use of color to differentiate components.
The flow chart is clear and well-structured with a descriptive title, legible labels for all nodes and gates, and no text overlap or clipping issues.
The line chart is clear and well-labeled with a title, legible axis labels, and a non-overlapping legend, though the y-axis label text orientation could be improved for better readability.
The waterfall chart is clear and well-labeled with a title, axis labels, and value annotations; all text is legible without overlap or clipping.
The chart is a clear Qini curve with legible labels and no text overlap or clipping.
The system architecture diagram is clear and well-organized with a title, legible labels, and no text overlap or clipping.
